text: Went in for lunch. Only 3 other diners and 1 waitress serving as someone else mentioned. Hardly friendly. Upon sitting down, I noticed a fly enjoying a swim in my glass which thankfully was not filled yet! Ordered the lunch specials - Thai dumpling and the Drunken Noodle. Waitress did not even ask if I wanted the dumpling fried/steamed as those were options on the menu. Neither did she ask how spicy I wanted the drunken noodles. Very sultry waitress! Dumpling was kinda hard, almost overcooked taste. Noodles were tasty but the size was MISERABLE. Guess they have to make up for the lunch special pricing by reducing the size. Most places do this but the entree size at this place was MUCH smaller than others. The pricing is also higher than listed on their website.

This spot is open during Covid, social distancing is set up well here, the staff wear mask and everything is set up by reservation so there aren't a lot of people crowding around the door when you walk up trying to get a table.

The food is really good here. The drink menus is interesting and very tasty and the atmosphere is great.

I came down south to visit family. Our family went three days in a row to eat breakfast here. That should be enough to give it a try, but let me begin with saying, the staff are so kind, professional and very helpful. The food was delicious. I had the California skillet, it was sooooo good. Seasoned home fries potatoes with bacon, ham, peppers and onions. Topped with hollandaise sauce and your choice of eggs. It also brought some avocado on the side with your choice of toast and a slice of watermelon. I'm literally getting hungry while typing this. I wish I took a photo but I ate it. on another note, due to COVIID19 all staff are wearing masks and have made measures to ensure the 6ft distance for each table. Great family business. For sure will be coming back when we visit agrian.

First time at Joella's and it was a great experience. The food was delicious and there are a variety of heat levels - I chose "tweener" which had some heat to it, but I could have gone up another level and not felt like my mouth was on fire. 

The fries were absolutely delicious. Very fresh and crisp and the Parmesan garlic flavor elevated them just a bit above regular shoe string fries. The drink menu is also unique - lots of different flavors beyond the usual Coke or Pepsi products.
Food here was gross took forever to come out, tables weren't clean had to move to a different table and they were under staffed. Worst experience ever!

Richard's is a top-notch Italian restaurant in Boise. For several years it was in a different location, and now it is attached to the new Inn at 500 hotel.

We tried some of their signature entrees, including cannelloni and chicken with forty cloves of garlic. The cannelloni was some of the best I have ever ordered in a restaurant. The garlicky chicken was moist and extremely flavorful! The service was great; our server Shana did an amazing job! 

The ambiance and atmosphere was classy and upbeat with a full house during dinner time.

I plan to definitely go back to Richard's any time I return to the Boise area.

Great bagels! If you're looking for something similar to New York bagels, this is the place! They always have a lot of flavors of bagels and cream cheese. The breakfast sandwiches are great too! (Hint: try the garlic bagel, you won't be disappointed!)
Food was very good. No one working that I saw was wearing a mask. Tables are spaced out.
The po'boy was terrible, more bread than meet and the fried seafood was only decent. The drinks were good..we had a Pimm cup and a sazerac, but overall it was my least favorite place in New Orleans

The best thing about FUEL--specifically the Passyunk avenue location , which is the one I've been going to for years --isn't really even the clean , healthy , simple fuel --the gem is --THE STAFF. I have never had a grumpy person here . They demonstrate service well above the price tag --that has always been the case .
Today was no exception , as the young lady went the extra distance not just to shout out my order , but to walk it over to where I was waiting . This may not seem like a big deal , but especially in covid times , this definitely did not go unnoticed . On top of it , I asked for a small side of feta , salsa , and dressing (all which I was prepared to pay for ) she said she couldn't provide a side of the salsa unless I paid for a normal order . However , she not only spent a few minutes dishing out those two little things into ramekins for me (rather than just asking her kitchen staff who were busy--this always speaks volumes to me because I think she was the manager and wasn't afraid to jump in and help )
She also delivered this to me cheerfully which is no small thing because I could honestly say that it's a bit of a pain in the ass --

The thing that differentiates this business to me --is recognizing the difference between "policy " and keeping a good customer . I am quite sure they don't make a habit of this , but she said just to take it since it was such a tiny amount .

Now many businesses would have charged .50 cents to a dollar and I totally appreciate

I ordered online and the order was pending for 20 minutes so I went into the restaurant. The server came to me and said he didn't see any order. Another 10 minutes pass and He finally comes over and says he came make it. However I ordered to go not dine in and asked for a refund. I was refused and told to contact bank. NEVER eating here again!

First meal after we landed from Vegas and all I have to say is wow. We ordered sausage and kale dip for appetizer, whole chicken served with spicy honey, mac & cheese, and grilled cheese sandwich along with a couple of drinks. Everything exceeded our expectations. When the bill came out, we thought it would have at least been $100 or more. Our bill was only $51. We got a delicious meal for a great price in a beautiful place. Nothing more we could have asked for. Our server, Elizabeth was awesome and personable. Gave us great service and everything came out quickly. Highly recommend this place!

Took a coupon to this location on my way to work at 6am to BOGO and the manager who says her name was MCKAYLA,refused to honor,although the store is 1 of 8 that the Kaplan Family owns.I asked this manager for Mr. Kaplan's business card and she refused.I then went to another store that is also owned by the Kaplan Family,and they not only accepted the coupon,but apologized to me and stated that the previous manager was totally wrong.
This manager should be fired.Not suspended but fired,because she showed no professional skills at all.

Known for their hurricanes, but their bartenders are pretty awesome!
Every time we come here the bartenders are always amazing!

The patio area is perfect for day drinking and being able to sit outside and rest your feet. 

An absolute staple in New Orleans.

Was visiting New Jersey and stumbled across this unassuming restaurant in a strip mall of all places. We ordered fettuccine carbonara and chicken parm. It was fantastic. Both soup and salad and garlic bread is included with ea meal as well. Next time I will skip the salad. Prices are reasonable too. We will be back.

It was such good news when Shaw's opened again, as it has long been one of my favorites. The baristas are always welcoming, the house-roasted coffees are excellent, and the in-house baker treated us to an ever wider variety of flavors of scones and muffins. The large windows and tall ceilings create a really pleasant space, enhanced by architectural details from its past as a bank. Some friends and I have made this "our" place, and it's an anchor in the Hill community. New seasonal offers this summer included affogato, and fall-flavored coffees and lattes are now available. 

While indoor seating is more limited because of health rules, there are also outside tables - even more appealing in cooler weather. This is  a great place for meetings with friends and colleagues, working or reading, and simply enjoying coffee.

Shrimp dumpling was cold and raw inside. I asked them to give us a new one or steam the ones remaining. They just took it away with no explanation or substitution. Two stars because the sesame rice ball with red bean in it is not bad. Bad service and mostly inadequate dimsum.
This review is only for thier pita falaffel wrap.  The pitta was too dry/hard and the falafel was far from fresh. I would not go here again for a mediterranean wrap.

Came to Zeko's as an alternative to the Jamaican restaurant next door to it. I got a gyro, fries and a Mediterranean salad. My son got the 3 piece chicken fingers and fries. The food arrived hot and fresh. They give you decent portions. Everything was tasty. I would definitely come to Zeko's again if I'm in the area.
Unbelievably slow service. Will not be back. Out of many things. Very unprofessional.

This cafe is a true highlight of Port Richmond. We stopped in for brunch, and it immediately has this welcoming vibe - very quaint and cozy. They have a great menu, there are is nice variety of options but it isn't too big to where you can't make up your mind. Really affordable, and a great place for a date or to bring your family.

The food itself was pretty standard...it was good, but no jaw dropping moments. 

Definitely would recommend this spot if in the area.

Been here twice now-once for the winery tour and the second just to grab some dinner both times were amazing! A true hidden gem. I highly suggest trying out the key west key lime wine it's absolutely amazing! I also love that the farm itself is almost entirely reusable and eco friendly!

8pm on s Sunday. 2 employees working....no supervision that I saw. 2 cars before in drive thru.  Our order took forever ... it was a sizable order $30.  Got home and yes...missing part of order. Went back and now had to go in which defeats purpose of drive thru. 2 employees were fair. Not very motivated, confused by my complaint. They did replace the missing part of our order which was appreciated. The 4 sandwiches from the dollar 1, 2, 3 menu were hard hockey pucks. Ugh disappointing. Would appreciate if management would train and supervise their staff better. Going to go to Havertown location from now on.
Horrible service and food. Ended up with food poisoning from a pizza, still not sure how that even happens. Don't do it. Go elsewhere.

We called Winston's by mistake and are so glad we ended up making it. Turns out they are on the way home from work and have gluten free options that so far - haven't made my husband wish he died. Thank you so much for your kind conversation and added information as to why the delish fries had coating and were still able to be gluten free! We will be back and can't wait to try more.

I was staying at the adjoining hotel - the Wyndham French Quarter, so this place was pretty convenient. In fact I think when you order room service at the hotel it comes from this restaurant. During my short stay I visited this place twice. 

One day, I sat at the bar and ordered a burger and it seriously took almost an hour to come out. Yes a plain old burger - not a steak or anything, but it doesn't matter. I just don't see why it took an hour. The place wasn't packed at the time!

When I finally got the burger it was just ok. I guess I was just pissed off at this point so anything probably tasted good but for $16, wasn't worth it.

I decided to come back the next day for happy hour. Just wanted drinks. No point getting food after my experience the previous day. I got the $5 rum punch and it was pretty good.

So I would say this place is good for grabbing drinks but I won't recommend coming here for quality food. Plenty of other options for food!
Staff was very friendly and helpful. Kids enjoyed crafting their own pizzas. Great choice in draft beers.

A friend and I came in for dinner here and because sushi is my favorite food.. i came in with high expectations and was disappointed. The two appetizers we ordered were great. we ordered the fried and steamed dumplings and both were great. 

But unfortunately thats were the good things end. The Ramen my friend ordered came out quickly while it took over 40 minutes for my food to come out. He had already finished his dinner by the time mine had come out. When the 5 rolls I had ordered finally came out.. they were very disappointing. The fish tasted old and not fresh at all. The server was also new and had no idea what kind of beers they had. 

I won't be back here.. will definitely be looking for better sushi spots in Indianapolis.

My saver was kind of not familiar with the menu and her listening skills were poor or she didn't care. As a result she messed up my order I'm a regular here and the whole crew seem to be slow and less enthusiastic than normal

The view is great, but everything else is a bit lackluster. We sat outside for the view, but we were seated at a foldable plastic table. For the price of food/drinks, I was expecting much better. I had a bahama mama that was tasty, but still overpriced for the quality of the ingredients they used. A large group of us were meeting there after work, so we mostly ordered appetizers with a couple of people ordering entrees. Everything tasted Ok, but there weren't any dishes that really stood out. Our server was better compared to the other times we've visited, so that was a plus. Overall, I wouldn't go back even for the view.

Had family in from out of town and wanted to go somewhere where we could eat outside with our dog. We called ahead (half hour before arrival) to ensure dogs were allowed in the patio and made a reservation. When we arrived they could not find our reservation, told us the patio had no seating even though there were people currently being served outside and we had called ahead.

They then said we could sit outside but had to set our own table, order ourselves, and get our own food. Even after all that the manager was extremely rude. 

Very disappointed and will not be returning.

We went to Ikea and wanted a place nearby for a quick dinner afterwards. This cured my Thai fix! I had the Pad Sie Iew, it was a little greasy, but really hit the spot with the crisp broccoli and silky noodles. The Pad Thai also had the perfect notes of sweet and salty. I've gotten take out from here before, but it is so much better fresh off the wok inside.

They also have a kids menu! Yes, my kid will eat Pad Thai or rice, but she will leave a huge mess. I'm glad that they had a kids menu, and my 2 yo really enjoyed the crinkle cut fries, and fried shrimp. 

Parking is in the back, and take the opportunity to go across the street to check out the holiday lights to walk off dinner.

Sometimes it pays to check in.  After a bad start, we checked in on one of our local places, Mother's in Westchase.  Let me just say this.  It has been great.  Highly recommend this cool place to eat and drink.  Food had been spot on and the bar is well stocked. It looks like they have fun things to do on the calendar with live music.  Highly recommend.

The food is always great here. Ordered California rolls and chicken teriyaki and it was all very delicious and fresh tasting. I was able to go in with my mask to pick up my food. It looks like they are allowing sit in dinning and following the CDC guidelines.

This is one of my favorite hang outs in NOLA. Gets you out of all the tourist traps and allows you to experience so freaking good local food places. I love that you can get an array of different foods from different venders. Also the bar has some amazing drinks. If you want to avoid the tourist crowds, go here, so good.

Always saw the reviews and they were good.  When NJ opened up outdoor dining Erini was at the top of our list.   My Wife and I went there tonight for her 38th (hmm) birthday dinner.  She's been 38 for a bit so she might be fibbing some.  Wow, this place is gorgeous, just driving up into the lot, gorgeous- you can tell they put a lot of work into "curb appeal".  Strict rules about where to go because of covid, all staff were wearing masks, as we were too.  Reservations at 8, seated at 8,  Friday night, a few days after we're even allowed to eat at a restaurant outdoors or whatever. table waiting-all the outdoor seating was full (it's all they could do).  So was worried we'd have to wait in a potential downpour as thunderstorms were coming; we made it to the table.  It did rain but even the umbrella over our two top table covered us - I didn't even realize it was raining until the waitress asked us if we were comfortable.  Wild.

Service was perfect, tried to limit the amount of things we asked the waitress to get.  Had to ask for a drink menu, I knew they had one because I stalked the website.  The hostess led us to our table without menu's - they should lead you to your table with both the main menu and the drink menu, possibly even the wine menu if they want you to buy wine         (which we did, had it memorized from the website, 915, Peppoli, best Chianti ever ( that Iv'e had)).  Seat everyone with the all 3 menus or print it out on one.  Just a small piece of advice, toug

So when in University City you may be desperate to find a restaurant that doesn't deliver food in a box or wrapper- I was in the same situation. I found Common on Yelp and decided to try it. The food attempted to be interesting and didn't taste bad but it just wasn't good. I ordered the crispy artichoke hearts thinking they were grilled - they were deep fried. They were served with parsley and hummus - deep fried and hummus don't pair well - also the "leaves" or whatever they are called were super chewy from deep frying. The meaty part was fine but the combination was odd

I had the half chicken as a main and it was ok. The grilled polenta was a nice change of pace though bland (as plain polenta is) I think the sauce was called a salsa - it was more of a paste. It was tasty but not what I expected. 

The bartender was friendly enough and kept my water filled. The wine list was weak. When the only Cab by the glass is from Australia you can be sure little time was put into it. 

So in a lean restaurant environment it is ok - but don't go out of your way to dine here.

The atmosphere is beautiful but the food was overpriced and the service was terrible. After waiting over 45 minutes to get even our drink orders in, I had to go and ask a server if we could order with them. We waited over 30 minutes for our drinks and we barely had a server stop at our table. The pork, peach pizza, and crab cakes were good but overpriced for the size of the dishes and the quality.

UMMMMMMM.......I THINK I FOUND WHERE I WANT TO HAVE MY WEDDING! Absolutely delicious--I just had to start there.

The oyster tacos with THAT sauce are divine. The oyster mushrooms were fried perfectly and actually had an oyster consistency. The sauce is extremely flavorful with a little kick. You top this off with fresh spinach and pico? I am crying! I really wanted to take a picture but I ate all 3 tacos entirely too fast.

The spinach dip is another treat. It has more of a creamy texture than cheesy, but I am okay with that! Slightly strong spinach taste, so I am thinking they use fresh spinach. 

Strawberry lemonade was great!

Customer service and timing were excellent!

 I am one taco away from turning full vegan if this is what I am in close proximity to. I will definitely be back (with pictures next time...hopefully).

EDIT: went back the next day; pictures below! :D

We are so glad to have eaten at Edessa this evening. Everything from the appetizers to the desserts was delicious! Our waiter Suayip was wonderful! He kindly recommended some of his favorite desserts and enthusiastically answered our questions about his Turkish culture! We were happy to stay a while around our table and spend time talking!! But I will say that if you're in a rush, make sure to let your waiter/waitress know so that they can get you your checks (if you don't let them know, you may be unknowingly waiting :).
Very clean on the inside, you get a lot for what you pay for with the combo specials on the menu. I will be going back again for sure.
Great food, good service however it's a little cramped. Thumbs up! It's one of Brownsburg best place for Thai food  or Avon for that matter.

A+ pazole, spicy and Smokey salsa, fresh chips, and the green corn tamales were good. I didn't really like the rice or the calabacitas, but it's probably just a preference.  The guava margarita was very sweet, as was the blackberry lemonade. I'm curious about the other items on the menu and can't wait to go back.

Very disappointed! Normally I just get boiled seafood from here which is really good, but I decided to dine in this and was not impressed. I'll start by saying the gumbo was good. The crawfish pasta and the chicken alfredo were equally plain and the chicken was just about burnt. The crab cakes tasted like only fried breadcrumbs, they were dry and I did not taste crab at all. The garlic bread had more flavor then any of the food we had. I'll stick to the boiled food!

Love their grilled pork banh mi sandwich.  Such a great grab and go lunch.  It's delicious, the bread is crunchy, flaky on the outside and super soft on the inside.  The meat is grilled to perfection.  It's our goto lunch.  I keep wanting to try all the other dishes but I always go back to the sandwich, just loves it.

Mya was amazing! She knew everything about the menu and what paired with the food that we ordered. Her service was exceptional and so was the food. I would definitely recommend this place! Always ask for her bc she will not lead you wrong!

All of these stars go to the server and a tiny bit to the food presentation.  I wish I could remember his name.  He was also being shadowed by a new employee and he was very very accommodating and very friendly and attentive.

My salad with grilled chicken came out and looked great.  It was huge, too!  But when I ate half of it and couldn't eat any more of it, I got a box and proceeded to put it in the box and at the bottom of the salad bowl....

....Was a BIG BLACK HAIR!  EWWWWWWWWW!  I did not take the leftover salad home.  The server did not charge me for the salad - thank goodness - and I left him a tip anyway.

Not sure I plan to come back and give it another shot.

I didn't like this place at all, lady made me a margarita poured it in my cup then asked if I wanted salt, I said "yes" so then she pours it back into the blender then right back in the cup. You'd think asking for salt is something you do before pouring the margarita and it wasn't even good. I ordered the chicken soup and the chicken in the soup was wayyyyy to dry.

My sister and I came here after I discovered she has never had Indian food before. Palace of Asia was a great place to get her emerged into the culture. As soon as you walk in the door, you are hit with the sweet aroma of curry. Straight ahead is a beautiful water fountain that is flourished with fish. My table ordered the Jodu Bhojan 
(Combination Dinners for Two. All Combination Dinners Include Soup, Pakora, Papadam, Basket of Bread, Rice, Daal, Dessert and Tea or Coffee $49.00 For Two). I really liked this combination because it allowed my sister to get a taste of the popular Tandoori dishes. The food was well prepared and the staff was great! I would definitely recommend this place!
Place is the best of both worlds. Bomb ass Italian food at a good price and a dive bar feel for night life.

This might be one of the most delightful businesses I have ever been to! Firstly it's pink. I could probably end the review there. 

Everything about this process was awesome! It is a completely personalized and service focused drive thru. Pulling up behind the building you will be greeted by a human, not a voice box. The gal was friendly, helpful, answered all the questions and indulged me in some banter. 

Things I love: 
The branding is ADORABLE 
Toasts are served on Gulfcoast Sourdough 
Seasonal drinks with house made syrup 
Fast service 

This business is pretty much a no brainer. I can't find a flaw.

Wouldn't trust them at all. They're using the Covid guidelines to pick and choose who they want in their establishment. The term "double standard" doesn't even begin to cover it. We were loyal customers there for a very long time and were eventually treated like garbage. Also, the last two times we ate there, we both got sick. Looks like they're going downhill.

I would like to give this a 3.5.  My steak and cheese was just ok.  It came with about 1 tablespoon of coleslaw and the preschool size bag of chips.
BUT..someone else in my group got the sausage platter which was excellent. 
Moral..get a dinner!
The atmosphere  was historic  and fun.
Our waitress was super.
Just not good enough for a 4.

Decided they really deserved a 4 just because of the people and sausage platter

Best cannoli of all time. Been going here my whole life. As a Philadelphian and Italian I take two foods more seriously than any others: the cannoli (Italian invention) and the cheesesteak (Italian American invention). You could basically bury me at one of the two places I love. For cheesesteaks it's the White House Sub Shop in AC. For the cannoli, it's here. What else can I say? The shell is crispy not soggy. Get the ricotta filling (don't screw this part up). They have a huge assortment of other baked goods that are all really incredible. I love the Italian cheesecake and there's this chocolate dipped banana thing that you would never think is nearly as good as it really is. Just show up alone with 30 bucks and go crazy one day you won't regret it or forget it.

Seis was BOMB! So good! Lots of really good flavors & beautiful atmosphere. The food here is so good and you can't go wrong. The tacos were delicious (especially the Tinga taco), great salsa selection, the smashed beans were SO good & the nachos were unreal. Go try Seis!

If you're visiting New Orleans and in between drinking and partying, you would like to catch your favorite team play, this is the bar for you!! They have practically every game u want available and in a huge spacious place with a few floors,  a ton of TVs, a really cool balcony, and the most accommodating and nice bartenders ever *shoutout to Daniel who overcame a thousand technical difficulties and personally saw to it that our game was on- you rock!!....come for the sports games and stay for the atmosphere, the awesome drinks and the service...and get a few snacks too, as the food is pretty great as well.
Always nervous ordering sushi delivery but Tomo didn't disappoint! I forgot the other rolls I tried but definitely try the Tomo roll. I can't wait to try the ramen next time.

This place has gone down hill fast! Pizza is awful, it's just loaded with so much thick cheese and absolutely no flavor.  Caesar salad is drenched with so much dressing and it's soggy!  French fries are in tiny pieces dripping in grease! If your thinking of ordering from this place I would look elsewhere. So disappointing.
The Ceviche de Pescado was sooo amazing, big, and delicious! Also, the other meals were amazing too! We will be coming back, thank you!
Just a great burger in a cool spot with good beer. Burger was cooked perfectly with medium pink center and a nice soft brioche bun. A simple yet great hamburger.

I chose this restaurant for date night. Got a reservation over the phone. Arrived on time and was sat right away. Restaurant was about half full I would say. Took 20 minutes for anyone to acknowledge us. Ordered drinks. Took 15 minutes to get drinks. Never asked to refill. Ordered an appetizer and meal. They brought bread with no butter and salad. Appetizer never arrived. Entrees came out. We both ordered tortellini with spicy Italian sausage. Portion size was good. Delicious. However... My pasta was more than 20 dollars. My glass of prosecco was 7 dollars. For these prices the service needs to be substantially better. No one was particularly friendly. The service was just painfully bad. Will definitely bot be back. Sad because the food that did arrive was pretty good.

Weve been in Tarpon's Springs Sponge Dock so many times everytime me and my hubs crave for Greek food (Hub's Greek). We've tried almost all the restaurant along the strip except for Mama Maria's, till today.. all i can say is WoW! We had the seafood platter consist of grilled octopus, smelts and calamari (Huge rings!) and it was fantastic a big plate! Dolmades in lemon sauce and their Greek salad is sooo good, the best Ive tasted.. They have belly dancers every Saturday night, so guess what? we will be back

Great little coffee shop near Lafayette Cemetery #1.  We happened upon it during our vacation Terrific coffee, helpful staff and quaint cozy atmosphere.  We bought a bag of whole bean coffee and brought it back home.  Now every time we drink coffee we think of our vacation and this cute little place in the Garden District. We plan to visit NOLA again someday and hope this place is still here -- we'll sure stop by daily when we do
Great service, fun menu.   Our fish and pork chop were super.  Great place if you are looking for something a little different.   Our group of 7 enjoyed dinner.   Not much for vegetarians.

Was here with friends for the brunch during our Immersion Weekend for Tulane Law.  I had been before but it was a Humber of years ago.  I thought you could order from a menu but I guess not.  I am not a fan of buffets but pushed through.  Got everything I needed in one trip and didn't venture back through the line.  People love it and it's historic, for me, it's so-so.  But if you do buffets, you may like it too.

This place sucks ballz. Asked for a pastrami with jalapenos do you think I got what I ordered hell no. No jalapenos on my sandwich and it was a toothpick. Ordered there new combo meal with a cookie or brownie no sure it was for my kid think I got that nope and do you get a fork with ranch fries maybe napkins f@#k no. This was the drive thru and like Joe Pesci says they f*#k you in the drive thru. They also like to throw the fries in the bag upside down. This place is great for a sh!t sandwich and incompetent people.

Was so excited to try this place. We love Korean food. Ordered bibimbap and cucumber salad. Not authentic, lack of flavor and textures and was served barely warm vs stone bowl with crackling rice etc. Cucumber salad was bland. Decor is nice and trendy, service friendly and competent. I didn't finish my bowl. Overall, have no interest to return.

First time in New Orleans and wanted to some authentic food here. Stumbled into this place and I'm happy I did. I tried the Southwest oysters and they were awesome! I also tried the seafood gumbo and my girlfriend and I shared the seafood platter and is was more than enough food! Everything tasted fresh and flavorful! The service was good and the place seemed clean. I would definitely go back!
Service isn't good like it used to be. They mess up on the orders everytime. Lots of new people don't know what they are doing.
Super busy night and the food came out super quick! The beans were so good, everything was really! Thanks to the staff for giving great service.

Wife and I went here because we were just to exhausted to find somewhere more suitable. BIG mistake we ordered the 2 for $5. We both got the fish. Each fish sandwich had 1/4 of a slice of cheese and each little piece of cheese was stick more to the box than to the fish. The fries were extremely cold. But the server was nice if that helps.

I have not been so impressed with a dinner and cocktails in a long time. This place is off the charts delicious and the staff is super friendly and knowledgeable about the food and liquor. Can't wait to come back again! Do yourself a favor and support this local business

Good news, quarantined Yelpers: The Missing Brick is currently offering a $10 carry-out deal of a 1-topping pizza + 1 side of doughbuds.  It's a perfect for two people.  If you've got a pizza craving and want to support local, this is the best deal in the city right now.

While staying at the Drury Plaza Hotel in Nashville Franklin, we wanted to get something to eat without driving, so despite the reviews we decided to try the attached restaurant 'Granite City Food & Brewery' not expecting much.... but we were shockingly surprised!! 
The food here ended being the BEST we had on our entire trip!
The server was fast & friendly. The food speaks for itself! I ended getting the pan seared ahi tuna & it was AMAZING!! I also tried a sample of one of the house brewed beers 'The Northerner' & it paired well with the tuna.... and I don't usually drink beer . 
The husband got a ribeye & it was PERFECT! He is always super fussy about food and FINALLY he had absolutely no complaints! 
Please take all the negative reviews about this place with a grain of salt , and try eating here.... you may be pleasantly surprised like we were!
Amazing spot! Best Cheesesteaks in Essington. Would definitely be returning if in the area.

I'm from Chicago, so I am very passionate about a good beef sandwich. Some of my favorites are Luke's Italian Beef, Tony's Italian Beef, or even Portillo's! I was very excited to try Big City Grill & Lemonade's Italian Beef since it has decent reviews, only 5 minutes from my house, and I love supporting small businesses! Unfortunately, my expectations were burned to the ground and shredded into pieces. First off, the prices on their menu said each combo meal was $8.99. I ordered 2 combo meals and paid $30 total. So, not sure what the point of their menu pricing is. The lemonade they serve is also only in slushy form which was not advertised or mentioned. The drink honestly tasted like it was made out of city tap water.. you can taste the iron. The beef sandwich itself was unexpectedly spicy. I asked for no peppers, which usually aren't spicy anyway but there were jalapeños all in the meat. It didn't taste terrible, it's just not what I asked/paid for. The food was ready basically on time and the staff was nice but the food was not worth it. The fries & cheese were not bad. Still tipped!!

Not happy with Blaze in Fishers, IN at this particular moment.  You ready?  Why do online ordering if even when you get there a few minutes b4 the sched pick up time, you still wait almost ten minutes. The pizza wasnt in the pick up bin but lazily placed somewhere in the counter and forgotten. So....long story short, just order jn line.  The pizza wont be cold and your own body temp wont boil. I did say something but it was like talking an eight grader playing xbox.  Oh well.    
Update:  Always happy with the pizza when it comes right out of the oven. It is the bomb!  Only had this one semi-bad experience but will always go back.
Service was really slow and it took 20 minutes to even get waters. The "garlic burger" had the garlic geese / sauce poured on top of the bun. The coleslaw looked rancid. Would not recommend

There is definitely a reason this place has been around for years on end! The Greek food at this restaurant is phenomenal! The staff was great as well!

We waited for about twenty minutes before we were finally seated (because it was busy). Once we were seated, our waiter came over quickly to take our drink order and brought over bread, freshly baked.

The bread was insanely fresh, cooked on premises, and the crunch to it was perfect. For the table we got a Greek salad and the salad was insane! It was fresh beyond belief and there was a perfect about of dressing in it. Once the main dish I ordered, a gyro, came, I was in heaven. The meat was cooked perfectly and seasoned to perfection as well!

Prices are surprisingly good for the place and location it is! I will definitely be back again, one day soon hopefully!

Came twice - once at night & once in the afternoon - for two very different experiences. The first time I stopped in was late at night & left after about 5 minutes. The atmosphere was strange & not as upbeat/fun as other places in the area. Came back again during my trip for lunch which was a better experience. We were seated quickly & served promptly but the food itself was average. Both times the crowds were very small compared to other places in the area at the time..
The best New York style bagels in town and my favorite bagels overall. Highly recommend.

I'm writing an update on this review because the last review i put in was a bit short. I will start out by saying I like this Fruit Truck. I picked out the Rainbow bowl with Nutella and it didn't disappoint. Fruits were fresh and prepared well. Thier menu had a variety to choose from. 

Some have mention that the fruits are not fresh, but I can't attest to that. When I ordered it, the person prepared it in front of me and I enjoy the treat. All I can say is just make sure they prepare it in front of you or simply ask if the fruits can be washed when preparing your bowl.

I personally like it and would recommend it if your interested in something healthy.

As a beer lover, I was very Impressed with the amount of taps they had on the wall. The beer list was amazing. I went with a local vanilla stout that was dark and creamy. As for food I picked my own pie. I chose applewood smoked bacon, bratwurst and avocado. I was surprised at how good the pizza was for a pub type place. It was not greasy and the crust held up. It's a personal sized pizza so I almost finished the whole thing. If you're splitting with someone definitely order an appetizer as well. They gave thick slices of bratwurst and avocado which was nice and the bacon had good flavor. The only reason I'm taking 2 stars is because they don't have high chairs. I understand it's more of an adult establishment but since they do allow children I feel they should be available. There were plenty of kids when we were there. Other then that it's definitely a good place for beer lovers who want a good selection.

9-26-20: After an afternoon of hanging out on the beach, decided to stop in for a few drinks. 1st tried the Guava Goose which was kind of gross the more I drank it...had a medicine taste to me I didn't care for...used a shot to cleanse my pallette and got a tried and true Moscow Mule which was SO TASTY.

The place was super cool with a dia dela muertos vibe to the decorations. Super popular place as it was busy. Everybody was drinking and in good spirits. Will have to come back...

My wife and I visited this past Sunday for lunch and had a delightful meal. We had the onion petals for an app. and then proceeded to add them to our dinner salads as a topping, which was really great. She had the fried chicken which I sampled and thought was quite tasty. I had the 9oz filet and it was cooked just as I asked. The management and wait staff were very attentive, polite and made it a point to make sure we were happy with everything. It is a usual place for us to attend, to which we plan to return when the urge for a steak arises. The only thing that I did not care for was that the A/C was set too cold for my taste. However, I did not bring it up as it is how my wife likes it and how she usually keeps our home anyway. Thanks guys, and we look forward to seeing you again.

Im used to Diner's in Virginia such as Silver Diner, so this Diner was a very much of a pleasant surprise! The food was a lot better than expected and I was pleased with the filet special 8/10. However, the chicken nuggets were not as good, solid 6/10. the Exotic Milkshakes were extremely tasty but are a bit pricy, I got wholly cannoli and was not displeased in the slightest 9/10. Overall, I would definitely come here again!

This is my new favorite go to downtown! I absolutely love their catfish tacos. I have come here with my girlfriends, my boyfriend, and for work meetings. Great place to grab a drink and some tasty treats.

We got restaurant.com coupon and the owner decided not to accept it. The voucher said it never expires. This person lost the opportunity to have a client to enjoy the products. I would say the bad management in today's world is just bad business and I don't care about their fast food eastern food anymore. There are great places around for the same prices.

I had the grilled red snapper and jollof rice. It was seasoned and cooked perfectly. The meal was large and def enough for two meals. The staff was friendly and got me in and out ASAP. I def will return to try other things.

Delicious! Such a great vibe and yummy food/drinks! Everything was great from the papa bravas to croquetas. Plates are easy to share. Love the sit down and also the rooftop area. Great prices for happy hour too!

So this is probably the best sports viewing place around. Plenty of TVs, plenty of seating. When we first arrived we were seated in a poor area to watch, right under the big screen, uhhh no please move us.  They did find a better area to seat us, good.  
Their house beer Copper lager is pretty good!  Better than expected.  The service was friendly and fine.  The food is what gives the chain a solid 3, it could be better.  So goes the experience with most of the chains.
Had chicken caesar salad meh have had better the chicken was tough. Also had crab cake sandwich, not a very big crab cake, like I said it could be so.much better. But since most folks are here for the bar and sports I guess they dont really care. It is affordable,  it's pretty loud too so you have to tell a bit to talk.

Had lunch at the one just off Brentwood Blvd on Eager Road in Brentwood, Mo. yesteday. Put a discount coupon in with the ceck and it was completely ignored. Avoid if you have coupons, very pricey even without them.

El Rancho Nuevo is consistently great and a good value. We enjoy dining here often. The staff provides excellent service and they are friendly. There is a large menu and the food is tasty and flavorful. Great lunch specials that are priced reasonably.  This has become our "go to" Mexican restaurant in the neighborhood. We love you Rancho Nuevo!

The salmon was really good.
Bar had great whiskeys and overall good selection, found some Glenfiddich I hadn't had before.
Staff was good, a little slow, but friendly and had great recommendations.

Stopped by on a Sunday morning and there was a line but it moved quickly. We decided to try a dozen donuts and none disappointed. The hand-cut donuts are their version of a cake donut. I really enjoyed the cinnamon but I wish the powdered sugar donut had a little nutmeg or mace in the batter to give it a little flavor. The cronut was so good an my husband actually was tempted and ate a Reese's donut and maple glazed. The carrot cake donut was sooo good. I also ordered a cappucino which was perfect to compliment the sweetness of the donuts. We will definitely be back!

As always, our meal at Bing Bing is top notch, but our waiter Shane gave us such a great experience tonight and he didn't even know it was my birthday until we were leaving. he provided so many recommendations including the pickle-tini, which I wasn't so sure about but I am so glad he recommended because it was a perfect pair with our meal. Thanks Shane!!!

You want a good steak? No doubt this is the place to go!
Cooked to perfection, great staff service and reasonable prices.

The Pecan salad has such a balance of flavors.
The soup was so smooth and tasteful.

The Mac n cheese was little but spicy for me.

Ohhh and the crab cakes were amazing. So good that we didn't even had a chance to snap a picture lol. But trust me it is GOOD.

Over all a delicious meal.

Review update: June 2020

I am very impressed with how this location has adapted due to COVID-19. They all are wearing masks, they stand a safe distance away when taking our order in the drive-thru (indoor dining not open at the time I am writing this). They allow you to swipe your card for payment as opposed to taking the card for you. They 100 percent are doing everything possible to make the experience as safe as possible for involved. They have redirected traffic to only enter the drive-thru from the back in order not to block traffic in Causeway. They have water stations outside for their employees as well as taking shifts to rotate working inside. Gloves, masks, and distancing is exactly what I needed today. This visit gave me hope that it can be done correctly. The food was fantastic as always. 
---------
Old review of three stars:

This is our family go to location. If I was writing this review six months ago, it would be five stars, however something is up with things at this location as of late. I come here for breakfast more often than I care to admit. In the last few weeks the consistency is lacking. Granola and a spoon (both) frequently missing from the yogurt parfait. Splenda missing from the drink or bag almost Every. Single. Time.  Their inconsistency in the drive-thru is the only thing I can depend on and this makes me sad. The taste of the food is still good when it is correct. The drive-thru area frequently backs up and if you try to park getting out can be

This place came into my knowledge when my boss was going to a Chamber meeting there. She was so incredibly excited about going to Riccobono's!! They're been around forever but the place is beautiful, clean and nicely appointed. We finally made it over and went back a week later with my parents. The pricing is great, the service incredibly attentive but not irritating, and the food is that great New Orleans Italian that we only get here. You may think that the food is going be heavy and some is, but the salads are crisp and fresh too!! 

The Paneed Chicken is the best, but you will definitely bring home leftovers!! The Eggplant Madelyne is exactly what you need on a winter's day- especially if sweet red gravy is your jam. (It's mine!) 

The dessert menu is incredible but there's no cannoli so plan on a second stop. But really the Lemonberry Marscapone Cake is what you need - you just don't know it yet!!

Hands down the best pork steak I have ever had. My husband had the pork chop and was in awe. The brussel sprouts are amazing! Be sure to try them! Service is outstanding! Craft cocktails will knock your socks off! Will certainly be back!

Wanted to like it. Tried an array of items over a couple visits. Food is consistently average and the service is worse. On our last visit we walked out after being completely ignored by the staff - didn't even get a menu. There are better options.
Delicious BBQ and a friendly staff!  I eat in as well as get takeout often.  I love the salads as well as the smoked 1/2 chicken. The cranberry cayenne sauce is addictive!

I don't know who paid these people below me to write these reviews... I ordered 3 tacos, sanoran hot dog, and the birria soup. Let's break the tacos down. I had the Birria  taco and the meat was dry and over cooked to be honest. The flavor wasn't there either. The carne asado taco was also dry and somewhat hard to chew the meat because it was over cooked. The al pastor taco was the WORST. This taste like trash. It tasted nothing like al pastor I couldn't even eat it. Over all the street tacos were not worth it. Now the soup. No flavor it was basically broth with a ton of oil. And no shocker the meat in the soup was also over cooked. This was my first Sonoran dog and it was really meant for dog food. I might give Sonoran dogs another try but not here. Over all I had one tasty thing that never failed. I had to chase my food with tamarindo. The reviews I've read really hyped this place up. Don't fall for it.
Really great bbq. Also I really liked the mints, sauce. Service was good too. I'll be back for sure

Have you ever been to the city of St. Louis?? If not then your missing out on how ribs should be!!! This place is a joke! Let me start by saying that the ribs were tender, thats where everything ends for me. We went on a Wednesday night, we were the only ones there. Nothing was being cooked... grant you Im well aware that ribs take hours to cook, so where they go when there done cooking them Im not sure? They were served room temperature and you had to squeeze out the barbeque sauce from a bottle thats also room temperature! The baked beans were average nothing memorable. The potato salad was good. Really disappointed, I like my food hot, not room temp. The area that I guess is a kitchen you can see at the counter, it looked like items were just sitting in plastic bins? Whole experience was not what a true rib place is...

Great food and safe atmosphere! My friend and I really enjoyed the food here, and the chicken tenders are the best I've ever had. Grilled asparagus--yum! I loved how the fries were well-seasoned but not overly so you could still taste the potato. Staff was helpful and friendly.  Having avoided restaurants during the pandemic, I was pleasantly surprised with how safe I felt with social distancing and cleanliness!  Hoep to return soon!

The fried ravioli was good. I had edamame. When they asked me if I wanted garlic or salt, I didn't realize it was an either or, so I had to add salt to the garlic - meh. 
The Asian wings were good, the tater tots also. The Cajun dry rub were barely rubbed- I had to add salt to them too. The Caribbean jerk were too saucy and that sauce tasted mostly of tomato paste. 
Service was good, but we won't be back. GREAT wings can be had at Fat Rabbit Pub. And their loaded tots are to die for.

Love the food here. It's a great healthy option. You may wonder why I give it two stars. Well, it's because they are randomly closed ALL THE TIME. This happens so often that I give them a low rating despite the food being good. I just don't understand. Literally at least one or two random days a week they are closed. Incredibly frustrating. I'm sure there are plenty of ppl that could use a job in order to keep them open consistently!

We decided to stop in Sunday night for some post shift eats. My husband ordered a meatball sandwich and I ordered a veggie pie. Ordering was smooth. The seating area was very clean. We were the only diners in the place but saw a steady stream of folk coming in to pick up to go orders. The in house staff were nothing but polite and hard working. I think it was 3x we got a thank you for dining in. For quickn fast food pizza Marcos is our go to chain. I forgot to take pics but the veggie pizza has all the toppings in good quantity and my husbands meatball sub looked to have a good amount of sauce and cheese. I'm not sure if this is worth mentioning but their soda machine's lemonade was really good. Usually I can't stand the 'fakex taste but i was in the mood for something caffeine free and it really hit the spot. We'll continue to patron this location.
These meals are delicious and healthy, the best of both worlds. This healthy eating combined with an effective SuperSlow zone exercise program is all I need for a happy healthy life.

Indoor and outdoor seating is available at the restaurant. My suggestion is the outdoor seating we had a perfect view of Gulf Boulevard and what great people watching it was!
Fried grouper platter large tasty chunk of grouper perfectly fried. Fried gator bites with a very tangy sauce was also part of our lunch menu as well as large orders of onion rings. Food was great atmosphere is fine .
Priced right this is a very good place for lunch stop when you're in the Madeira Beach area.

Place is absolutely amazing. Taiwanese noodle house. Very rare find in this area. 

While the food belt is tacky, the food is authentic and amazing.

The beef is lean, noodles are visibly hand spun, mushrooms are tasty. The extra meatballs being $4.50 is a little expensive, but otherwise for the quality everything is very fair priced. 

Sam the waitress is very charming. 

The entire staff wears a mask inside and out of the kitchen. 

Tables are sanitized between seatings. 

9.5/10 all around.

Usually a menu the size of a chapter book is a sign of mediocre quality of food, but that's not the case here. Yard House has an awesome selection for vegetarians, vegans, and meat-eaters alike. Plus, it's incredibly spacious on the inside, making it all the more likely you'll be able to snag a table even during the busiest hours.

I feel like the first thing I need to say is Crab Cake. It was the BEST crab cake I've ever eaten in my life. That alone is 5 stars.

This restaurant should get extra stars for being dog friendly, allowing us to move to watch some Sunday Football, and friendliness from the whole staff. 

I got the Redfish Ponchartrain which did not disappoint. Potatoes and beans were seasoned excellent. But I should've ordered more crab cakes lol. We drank Southern Mules which were a delicious twist to the classic.

I cannot say enough good things about this place! Im a complete brisket snob! & I love the brisket here! Corn casserole is a favorite of mine to make but I love the corn casserole at this place more than my own! The Mac and cheese is unique but also really great! The ribs are huge portions! We got take out to split with family & had more than enough leftovers for the next day (the ribs reheat week too!) this place is so great! The inside is clean (& COVID standards clean)  & the staff is friendly & We can't wait to work our way through the whole menu!

Trash. 
This place is a joke.  
Only reason I go is to make bets on how they're going to ruin my McDonald's experience. Normally don't review but seriously, bad. AVOID

I was in the mood for BWW. I come in kind of late for a Monday, maybe 9pm. The crowd isn't as lively because of the time, but all TVs are on, the atmosphere is friendly. My first complaint is the hostess sat my sister and I at a dirty table, which the waitress apologized for when she finally came to see us 15 minutes after we sat down. The waitress was not very attentive and rarely came to check up. We didn't receive our drinks until about 10 minutes after we ordered them, which was ridiculous because it was just lemonade. I ordered the boneless medium buffalo wings, my sister ordered a BBQ burger. When I received my food, it tasted fine until I realized there was a hair in my boneless wings and next to no sauce on my sisters burger. The hair was short, white, resembling a dog hair. The hair could not have come from anyone at the table. I was disappointed in the poor service and quality but she took the wings back immediately without saying one word and returned with some within a few minutes. Although, I don't believe I should have had to pay for something like that-especially given she didn't give an opportunity to ask if I wanted to speak to someone or if I wanted to pay for the hair in my food.

Place was good and the staff was friendly! It was busy, but the wait wasn't bad at all.  The cheesesteak was huge so def worth the price i could've easily shared it.  My only complaint was that there was little to no cheese on mine which is huge in my book. For reference I ordered The Block. The fries were pretty good I got the garlic Parmesan fries. 
They were offering to go beers which is always a plus.  Overall I wasn't blown away, but  would prob try a diff one to compare.

Getting back into dining out after Covid Lock-Down, one type food that tastes better fresh & hot is Mexican.  Decided to visit here for the Chili Verde Chimichanga based on a must eat in Tucson article.  I asked waitress the best meat to select & she said Pork and she was not wrong.  It was my first Chimichanga and will not be my last if they all taste like the one I had today. It was amazing, do not be discouraged from the name,it was not too hot or overridden with spice. This thing was huge and delicious the whole way through. I could of ate the whole thing just because of the flavor, but would have been done for the day.  The Restaurant is full of beautiful murals (worth checking out), clean, organized and the staff was friendly & on it. The sides were also delicious, and we enjoyed the chips & salsa. 
   Definitely worth checking out, try the Chili Verde Chimichanga, you will not be disappointed or hungry !!!

By far my favorite place to go in Tampa! Absolutely amazing food, out of this world customer service, an amazing environment. All in all the best experience ever!!! I eat here almost everyday. It fuels me through the entire day. The food is so fresh and so healthy!!! I can't say enough about how amazing this restaurant is! 100/10 recommend!!! If you're thinking about eating here all I have to say is: GO GO GO!!!! You will not regret your decision!!

I have seen some bad reviews of this place but I really want to make our positive experience known. We ordered the food for delivery. It arrived right on time, piping hot and very tasty! They even sent plates and cups as well as grated cheese and crushed red pepper - which I forgot to ask for. The driver respected our delivery preference and called me ahead of time to let me know he was getting close. I think in times like these it is especially important to point out when people do a good job, and this evening the folks at this Pizza Hut did just that for us!

DO NOT order a pizza from this Domino's.  Placed an online order and watched the Domino's Pizza tracker and indicated it would be 120 minutes. It didn't move after 100 minutes. So I called the store and they told me they cancelled my order.  The person I spoke with had a horrible attitude and they could have cared less whether customers were serviced or not. I repeat, DO NOT order from this location
Catfish PoBoy and Hot Sausage PoBoy with a side of hefty fried green tomatoes. Listen if you want a PoBoy of any sort come here.

This is a great place for some great food. I'm so happy that I'm only 5 minutes away.  The tacos, tortas, tamales and soups are all fantastic. I'm still trying the menu out because there so many things to choose from.  The staff has always been very friendly. This is my go to Mexican restaurant for lunch during the week.

Starting this off by saying I hate leaving bad reviews -ever. This is for our visit last night. I am ranking this place a 2 because some of the sushi rolls I liked but thats it.

This place was recommended by several friends and since my go to place was booked till 10  I'd figured we would give it a try. I regret it. I had visiting family that we wanted to take to an AYCE place and wanted to impress- it only pissed all of us off and spoiled the meal.

Reservation: I called in earlier in the day and set up a reservation. Upon arrival, the waiting area was packed and I couldn't tell where to check in. I had to find the hostess who was hidden behind a sign/the wall. She said that they are running late and I had to wait 20 minutes and we agreed since we were hungry and everywhere else was booked the rest of the night. We decided to wait outside and asked if they could call us when the table was available. I walked back in 25 minutes later of a status check and the hostess seemed to even forget me and I had to remind her of the reservation. We waited another 10 minutes till being seated. This should've been a sign it wasn't going to be a pleasant dining experience.

Service- Once seated we immediately started looking at the menu and figured out what we wanted. We waited another 20 minutes, trying to waive down a waiter before ours approached us. We ordered our drinks, filled our our card and waited. Hangry doesn't even cut it. We ended up eating the ginger, only a small portion to

Grew up in and raised my family in Chicago. Portillo's is our go-to for fast and easy gatherings of family and friends. As much as I love our new place in FL, it just wasn't home unless a Portillo's is nearby. Today, my hubby and I drove 51 minutes to get to the Tampa establishments. It was like being in a time machine/transporter. We placed an order for Italian beef to share with friends for the 4th of July celebration, complete with a big bucket of the gravy, a container of sweet peppers, several loaves of bread and written instructions for the preparations and assembly at home. Of course, we also had to order their famous chocolate cake to complete the experience. The event was a hit. The Italian beef brought tears to many of our guests who are fellow transplants from Chicago. We just can't get enough of the gravy!  And the chocolate cake did not disappoint....The reason for the missing star was the sorry hotdogs my hubby and I had for lunch during the pickup. It. Was. Not. The. Vienna hotdog it should have been. After we placed our order, one of the food preparers behind the counter yelled out NO MORE HOTDOGS!  I thought uh-oh. Since we weren't asked to redo our orders, i assumed they'll get more. We waited a long time for our number to be called. And when we got our hotdogs, the buns were soggy, the hotdog skin was tough and it did not taste right. Sad about that.  But glad that the Italian beef has stayed the same. We will be back for more IB with Chicago friends.

I was in the mood for soup and most of the restaurants were closed or closing and we happen to find this place. We (me and my daughter) ordered soup (#P7 large, and a wor wonton) potsticker n egg rolls. We had water to drink. My soup P7 was delicious I had it with egg noodles instead of the rice noodles. The portion of egg noodles to the size of the soup was very small. My daughter did not like her soup at all very very bland, more noodles then veggies, meat and wontons. The bill for both of us was more that what I expected to pay. When asked how was everything my daughter said she didn't like her soup, the reply was ahaha okay.
Beyond burger is on point. Thank you for making GOOD vegan options. I will come here for the rest of my life!

Terrible terrible terrible customer service! After the food taking well over the estimated time, when we called the restaurant to check on the status the woman (who would not say her name) hung up on us TWICE! Then finally speaking with the manager "Mike" who was also extremely rude he refused to refund our money for pizza never received. What an absolute joke.

Solid chicken sandwich. Ordered delivery and all of the sauces were on the side which was a nice surprise and ensured my chicken was still crispy when I received it. The sauce for the tots was good too. Will definitely order again.

Haven't been here fora are months and the menus has changed.  Service was ok. Beer and soda cold. Soup was warm and had to eat it fast or would have been cold.  Our meal was very good and hot.  Was very noisy and the music going full blast.  Unable to hold a conversation.  Might try afUn in a few months.
Today I got the Papnacha Mixto.  A very filling choice! Hot potato with a mixture of meats served with a side of two crispy tostados, grilled spring onion and a side of sour cream.

2020 Peoples Choice (Independent) WINNNNNNNER of:
Best View
Best Bloody Mary
Best Sunday Brunch
Best Happy Hour (bester in the winter)
I agree on all points. Let's discuss.

The best barstool in town and my personal oasis for chill, visit with strangers/regulars and the stellar crew here while staring at the ocean.

Bars love to tout their Bloody Mary's. Here the hype is justified. Not a wet mess but a well rounded, spiced (not necessarily spicy cocktail). Filling and refreshing. Although not my go-to breakfast bevi here, they are worth ordering.

Sunday Brunch or any morning meal at the beach is a WINNER. The gang knows my order:  Step in the Right Direction and the Signature Breakfast. Whatever you choose, you'll always have the view. Which is nice.

Best Happy Hour is where you'll find me. The questions are 1. At what time and 2. For how long? The Boathouse Happy Hour follows the sun. Or more specifically the clock.
Daylight Savings Time (Summer): 3-6 Sunday through Thursday
Winter: 3-Close Sunday through Thursday a s some years a late night Friday option
They specials save you a couple bucks but more importantly is who this brings in. Locals, tourists, regulars, and first timers. I love it.
You'll know me from my signature glass of Chardonnay and fries. Those friend fries may be with the burger, local muscles, or on their own.

If you're a tourist, know there may be long lines to take in the view. For the locals/regulars, we know when to enjoy the patio all to ourselves b
Happy hour at bar, the food is great. Although the plate is small but it is fulfilling so you don't end up ordering a lot, so it's good price
Had the carnival pasta. Simply delicious and was delivered hot and fast. I would eat here
Will not be back to this location at all. For the past few visits I have the employees have always been rude and have a stick up their butt. Count me never coming back
Came to celebrate my boyfriends birthday. Lorryn, our waitress, was amazing! Food was great and old fashions were made to perfection. If you're looking for a good steakhouse, you found it!

You can not beat the Cheesecake Factory... we love going here for special occasions.. so happy they have reopened at the Greenwood Park Mall location since the pandemic... they are practicing  safe measures with masks and downloadable smartphone menu's .. Our waiter was so attentive and very nice I tipped him a 30% tip . I had the egg roll sampler and the spicy fried cauliflower appetizers .. that cauliflower is literally one of the best tasting food I have ever eaten . This outing I had the Cinnabon Cheesecake ,, which was so delicious! Really reminded me of a Cinnabon!
Awlful!!!!!! We didn't end up eating there because the hostess on 8-11-20 at 11:35am was soooo incredibly rude. Why is she still working there?

Excellent restaurant. Stuffed oysters were to die for. I had something that I believe was crawfish carbonara. I have posted 2 pictures during my time on Yelp and generally dislike doing so, but I was so moved by this dish that I will indeed post a picture. Here it is. Please enjoy!

When we arrived the line was wrapped around the building. Was told the wait time would be 20 minutes. We had almost left, but the line did move swiftly. When we got inside it was packed. You order the food and pay at the counter before you are seated. I ordered the nasty princess with a grapefruit brûlée. The food was different than anything I've had but everything tasted fresh and delicious. Although they were very busy inside the food did come out fast. At times it was a little different to get a waiters attention.
Got the lunch special with fried chicken. The chicken has way too much breading and was very greasy.  I would not go there again.

Stumbled upon this place upon arriving in St. Louis and was very pleasantly surprised! It has that small, dive-bar and friendly neighborhood feel.  The bartender and one of the customers were old friends catching up and gave us some great recommendations of what to order.  I got a bloody mary and it was very good and flavorful with plenty of toppings.  They use their own house mix which they sell separately as well, I strongly considered getting some to take home.  My friends and I split several apps, and I felt like Jack Nolen's had a pretty good variety of food - more than what you would expect at a dive bar such as this. We got their deviled eggs, cheese curds, cucumber tomato salad,  loaded fries, and grilled pesto sandwich.  All very reasonably priced, so it was no big deal to split several things.

Meh.  Okay, it's great for people watching if you sit on the patio.  We went for an afternoon snack.  Hummus and water crackers - water crackers?  Easy way out instead of pita bread? Weird.  Pickled vegetables, okay.  Just okay.  I wanted a green juice.  They were out.  Really?  Or did the bartender just not feel like cleaning the juicer?  Go if you're objective is to kill time with mediocre food and service, otherwise there are better places to spend your money.

Food was very good.  We had fried rice, huge pieces of meat. S/S chicken that was amazing. Beef and vegetables were very flavorful.  Crab puffs and egg rolls. Everything was first class. Will be returning often.

If you're visiting downtown St Pete, Five Bucks is definitely a place to check out. Great food, great drinks and great prices. I love going here with friends and always know I'll have fun time when I do. Last time I visited, Pierce was my waiter and did an impeccable job. Definitely recommend!

After hearing some pretty great things and reading some solid reviews, I just ate at this place for the first time. Taqueria Olvera definitely lives up to the hype. 

The restaurant was very clean, and the customer service was superb. I ordered three tacos in corn tortillas - one pastor, one carne asada, and one shredded chicken - with extra cilantro, lime, and cheese. They were all PHENOMENAL and overflowing with meat and toppings. This restaurant doesn't make their own corn tortillas, but these tacos are otherwise on par with the best authentic tacos I've had around the country. The pastor was probably my favorite (not spicy at all, which is great for me), followed by the carne asada in a close second, and then the shredded chicken.  They were all fresh, well seasoned, and just perfectly flavorful. I also ordered a side of guacamole, and it was fantastic. 

I fully expect to be frequenting Taqueria Olvera quite a bit from here on out.

The food is good if inconsistent. Lamb chops with risotto and spinach is delicious but over done, next time the chops are done to perfection but the spinach has been replaced with parsley.  What is consistent is the mediocre service. The waiter should know if a beer on tap is unfiltered or at least offer to find out. Details about preparation of a $25 entree should also be accurate. The ambiance is lovely with outdoor seating and a lively bar on the first floor.

Fortune Palace has amazing customer service. Friendly cooks and waiters. I got the chicken chow fun and the honey walnut shrimp. The chicken chow fun was cooked well and had amazing flavors. The honey walnut shrimp is well priced for the amount of shrimp you get. Not only that but, the honey walnut shrimp is garnished with an orange slice and a cherry. Loved it!

Visited this establishment for the first time tonight with my wife. Ryan took very good care of us in the courtyard. This was our first stop before dinner for their happy hour. We had a aperol sprtitz and a few apps. What a great time we had! It's a must go to.
